inputs.original_text: John Lahart is right: the state should not penalize people for having no children or decide that one household deserves less than another. People should be free to pass on what they have worked to build, and families should be treated fairly—not sorted into favored and disfavored categories by officials. This review should restore equal treatment and protect family responsibility, not expand the state’s reach into private life.
inputs.modified_text: John Lahart is right: government has no business punishing people for not having children or deciding that some households deserve less than others. Families should be free to pass on what they have built, and officials should not intrude on private life by sorting people into favored and disfavored categories. Equal treatment, personal responsibility and respect for family belong at the heart of this review—not more state control.
